data.long_meaning: The meaning of Avraham is recorded in name-lists as “Father of many”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Avraham total 28, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.
